sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels panicked and flustered, with a burst of frustrated disbelief at being late on the very first day and a strong urge to fix it immediately.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.text: You have got to be kidding me.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels exasperated and incredulous, with a burst of frustrated panic at how unfairly her already-bad first day is going.
sprite_sequence.label: anger

sprite_sequence.text: Come on, come on... move already.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is impatient and stressed, urgently willing the crowd to clear because she feels her already-bad morning slipping further out of her control.
sprite_sequence.label: anger

sprite_sequence.text: Okay. It's fine. New term, fresh start, and I'm sweating before homeroom.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is trying to psych herself up with upbeat determination, but underneath that she feels frazzled, embarrassed, and stressed about already being in a bad state on the first day.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is flustered and breathless from being late, but pushing forward with determined, apologetic urgency as she tries to force her way through the crowd.
sprite_sequence.label: fear

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: Breathless and relieved, with a burst of triumphant energy as she realizes she barely made it in time.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She freezes in sudden embarrassment and awkward realization, her earlier rush collapsing into a small, startled panic as she notices she has walked into the wrong room.
sprite_sequence.label: surprise

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is abruptly embarrassed and flustered, trying to recover her composure with a tentative, hopeful question while realizing she may have rushed into the wrong classroom.
sprite_sequence.label: surprise

sprite_sequence.text: Right! Great! Love that for me.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s mortified and embarrassed by the mistake, but is forcing a bright, joking front to recover her composure and keep from looking flustered.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is flustered and embarrassed from barging into the wrong classroom, but trying to recover with upbeat politeness and a quick, confident front.
sprite_sequence.label: surprise

sprite_sequence.text: Seriously? You may have just saved my life.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels intensely relieved and grateful, with a burst of embarrassed humor as she clings to the small rescue after a chaotic, humiliating morning.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.text: Here! Present. Very present. Extremely sorry.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and embarrassed from the morning’s chaos, but is trying to recover with upbeat, self-aware humor and a determined eagerness to make a good impression.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.text: I can't believe that happened before nine in the morning.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed and exhausted, but also relieved enough to laugh at her own disastrous morning now that the worst of it is over.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.text: Recovered? I entered the wrong class like I was making a dramatic entrance.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s embarrassed but laughing it off with self-deprecating humor, still energized and relieved that the mistake is already turning into a funny story rather than a disaster.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.text: Then I'll call it confidence and not a total disaster.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She’s joking herself back into composure, turning embarrassment into playful self-assurance and trying to frame the morning’s chaos as something she can laugh off.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness

sprite_sequence.text: Hey, since I already embarrassed myself in front of half the first years... want to stick together at lunch?
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels sheepish about her earlier blunders but is now relaxed, grateful, and warmly hopeful, using humor and openness to turn the embarrassment into a friendly invitation.
sprite_sequence.label: happiness
